decisions.decision: Reverted plan-prescribed dangerouslySetInnerHTML fix for GAP-1
decisions.rationale: dangerouslySetInnerHTML:{__html:''} caused React 18 to set innerHTML='' on first render, destroying React 19's canvas before the preview bundle mounted. Replaced with empty virtual children (no child createElement) — React 18 reconciler only manages fiber-tree nodes, never externally-added DOM children.

decisions.decision: Added MutationObserver on document.body in preview.ts
decisions.rationale: Gutenberg renders blocks asynchronously after DOMContentLoaded; one-shot scan missed dynamically-added divs. Body subtree observer catches them.

decisions.decision: Load preview bundle inside Gutenberg iframe via block.json editorScript array instead of enqueue_block_editor_assets
decisions.rationale: WP 6.1+ renders the block canvas in an isolated iframe. enqueue_block_editor_assets loads scripts in the parent document, which cannot see iframe DOM. editorScript-array entry loads the script inside the iframe where the data-khaveeai-preview-config div lives.

decisions.decision: Changed Plugin.php from enqueue_block_editor_assets hook to init-priority-9 wp_register_script
decisions.rationale: block.json editorScript references scripts by handle; the handle must be registered before register_block_type resolves the list. Registration (not enqueue) is editor-only because block.json lists it in editorScript, not script/viewScript.
